name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Brennen: live panes, commands and tools that run inside Claude Code

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Codex, Cursor and a second Claude inside Claude Code: an agent room (one chat, @mentions, handoffs) plus one-shot reviews and delegation

plugins.name: mod-firewall
plugins.description: A firewall for Claude Code mods: watches what every other mod does (network, processes, secret files, env vars) and asks, blocks or logs

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: See and message your other Claude Code sessions: who is working on what, direct messages, broadcast, handoffs, an inbox that holds incoming messages for approval, and live warnings when another session edited the same file

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache of an idle session warm with a tiny side question before it expires, for as long as you choose, then lets it expire, compacts, or clears with a handoff
